svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make four. Cut 630 mm of 45 x 35 mm timber, ends square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 10.5 mm holes through the 35 mm way, 585 mm apart, 20 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 25 mm in from the ends, on the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the four together clamped in a stack so they match.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the 45 mm face lies flat on the upright and the side rail.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: On each upright the front brace is on the outer face and the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: back brace on the inner face; one M10 bolt goes through both

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: braces and the upright at 520 mm above the ground.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The foot bolt goes through the brace and the side rail.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: with both bolts in, the upright stands plumb within 2 mm.
